D1-356
DIAGNOSTICS - SUPPLEMENTAL RESTRAINT SYSTEM
Short in P Squib Circuit OTC B0105/53
CIRCUIT DESCRIPTION
The P squib circuit consists of the airbag sensor assembly and front passenger airbag assembly.
It causes the SRS to deploy when the SAS deployment conditions are satisfied.
For details of the function of each component, see OPERATION on page RS-2.
OTC B0105/53 is recorded when a short is detected in the P squib circuit.
